title.zh: U.S. SEC begins prepping for around-the-clock trading that crypto treats as the norm
title.en: U.S. SEC begins prepping for around-the-clock trading that crypto treats as the norm

current_state.zh: The U.S. SEC held a roundtable on moving securities markets toward 24/7 trading and, in the same morning, approved tokenized securities trading, signaling a major regulatory embrace of crypto-style market operations.
current_state.en: The U.S. SEC held a roundtable on moving securities markets toward 24/7 trading and, in the same morning, approved tokenized securities trading, signaling a major regulatory embrace of crypto-style market operations.
